d_pound: Pound dribble. Pound the ball hard at your hip. Keep your eyes up.
d_cross: Low crossovers. Cross the ball low from hand to hand. Keep it below your knees.
d_fig8: Figure eight. Dribble in a figure eight around your legs. Stay low.
d_wraps: Ball wraps. Wrap the ball around your waist, then your head, then your knees. Go fast without dropping it.
d_tips: Fingertip taps. Tap the ball back and forth between your fingertips. Arms up high, then down low.
d_form: Form shooting. Stand close to the hoop. One hand, elbow in, and hold your follow through.
d_mikan: Mikan drill. Alternate layups on both sides of the rim. Keep the ball high.
d_catchshoot: Catch and shoot. Toss the ball out, catch it on the hop, and shoot in one motion.
d_pumpdrive: Pump fake and drive. Pump fake, take one hard dribble, and finish at the rim.
d_ft: Free throws. Same routine every shot. Dribble, breathe, shoot. Hold your follow through.
d_slides: Defensive slides. Get in a low stance and slide side to side. Do not cross your feet.
d_pivots: Jump stop and pivot. Jump stop on two feet, then pivot forward and back. Keep your pivot foot down.
d_wallpass: Wall passes. Chest pass to the wall and catch with two hands. Step into every pass.
d_quickfeet: Quick feet. Fast feet in place. Stay on your toes.
d_plank: Plank hold. Hold a plank. Tight core and a flat back.
